intro.text: A servant at Mercystar's palace in T'Telir.

items.text: Taff is with three other servants when Vasher breaks in and ties him up with an Awakened rope. By the time help comes, the rope is no longer Awakened and Taff has been stabbed to death. Questioning the witnesses, Lightsong works out that the intruder who first attacked was not the one who killed him.
